links.label: wrong_fact
links.note: The date is wrong: this is the 1489 first edition, not 1589. The page does link melancholy to Saturn.

links.label: cited
links.note: The aqua vitae passage, the thinned spirits and reaching the innermost secrets are on p.22. The 'denser, drier part of the blood' phrase is on p.19.

links.label: cited
links.note: Burnt bile, mania, sluggishness and torpor, and 'nothing is hoped for, everything is feared' are all on p.19.

links.label: cited
links.note: p.240 says Saturn is hostile to men who live a common life and a friend to minds separated from earthly things.
